title: Refund Policy
content: Our refund policy allows customers to request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. To initiate a refund, contact support@company.com with your order ID. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days. Digital products are non-refundable after download.

title: Account Setup Guide
content: To set up your account: 1) Go to signup page, 2) Enter your email and create a password, 3) Verify your email via the confirmation link, 4) Complete your profile. If you don't receive the confirmation email, check your spam folder or contact support.

title: Billing FAQ
content: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and PayPal. Billing occurs on the same date each month. You can update your payment method in Account Settings > Billing. Invoices are emailed automatically after each payment.

title: Technical Support Hours
content: Technical support is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. For urgent issues outside business hours, use our emergency ticket system. Average response time is under 2 hours during business hours.

title: Data Privacy and Security
content: All user data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. We are GDPR and SOC 2 Type II compliant. You can request a copy or deletion of your data at any time via Settings > Privacy.
